summary: A strong MIT, provenance-signed alternative to React Aria. Base UI is active, React 17/18/19 compatible, headless and smaller to install. The dialog spike opened with role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside, at 257.79 KB / 82.46 KB gzip. Use it as the approved alternative, not mixed with React Aria in the same surface.
reasoning: Active release line: 1.9.0 published 2026-10-09; repository pushed 2026-11-03; 11k stars and 449 open issues.
MIT with a permissive tree and no required CSS runtime.
npm provenance is present via GitHub Actions trusted publishing.
No install scripts and no recorded OSV advisories.
The React 19 dialog spike rendered role=dialog, labelledby and describedby, and moved focus inside.
The bundle was 257.79 KB / 82.46 KB gzip; about 30 MB installed with React 19.
The component set is broad but less comprehensive than React Aria for complex tables, date/time and internationalized collections.
caveats: Newer 1.x line; less long-term production history than Radix.
No local spike for tables, date/time or drag-and-drop; only the dialog path was exercised.
Do not mix Base UI and React Aria primitives in the same overlay or focus scope; pick one per surface.
The package was renamed from @base-ui-components/react; use @base-ui/react.
Peer dependencies include optional date-fns and @date-fns/tz for date components; they are optional.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: ^17 || ^18 || ^19. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 5 runtime dependencies; about 30 MB installed with React 19; 10.1 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled index.d.ts and per-component subpath types.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA provenance is present on 1.9.0; npm records GitHub Actions as the publisher via a trusted publisher.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800 with role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside. The JS bundle was 257.79 KB / 82.46 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: Broad primitives, but less comprehensive than React Aria for complex tables, date/time and internationalized collections.
